PKanalix file handler

Source: R/file_handlers.R
PkanalixHandler.Rd

PKanalix file handler

PKanalix file handler

Details

Reads .pkx projects, which share the .mlxtran section syntax. The input files are every file the project references (see project_file_references()): the data file, the model used by compartmental analysis when the project has one, and files such as separate dose tables. The output directory is the exportpath of <PKANALIX> [SETTINGS], or the project name next to the project file without one.

Results are read from PKanalix/IndividualParameters/ in the output directory, one folder per task: nca/ncaIndividualParameters.txt, ca/caIndividualParameters.txt, ca/cost.txt and be/confidenceInterval_<formulation>.txt. They give the tasks with results (tasks, in the order nca,ca,be), the number of individuals (n_individuals, unique id in the NCA parameters, else in the CA parameters), the CA criteria (-2LL as ofv, AIC as aic, BIC as bic, Cost as ca_cost) and, per formulation and parameter, the bioequivalence ratio, its confidence interval and conclusion.

Method result_files()

Result files of a run into output_dir: the individual parameter tables of NCA and CA, the CA cost table and the bioequivalence confidence interval tables

Usage

PkanalixHandler$result_files(output_dir, files = NULL)

Arguments

output_dir

Output directory of the run

files

Character vector of candidate file paths, such as the recorded outputs of a run. NULL (default) looks in output_dir.

Returns

The result files among files, or those that exist in output_dir when files is NULL

Method parse_results()

Parse PKanalix result files into the content of summary.json

Usage

PkanalixHandler$parse_results(files)

Arguments

files

Result files to parse, as returned by result_files()

Returns

A list with summary_stats, observations (empty) and bioequivalence (one entry per formulation and parameter), or NULL when the files cannot be parsed
